definitions.explanation: any material that has been printed, including books, flyers, pamphlets, and postal printed matter

examples.japanese: {印刷物|いんさつぶつ}は{安|やす}い{郵便|ゆうびん}{料金|りょうきん}で{送|おく}れる。
examples.english: Printed matter can be sent at a cheaper postal rate.

examples.japanese: {大量|たいりょう}の{印刷物|いんさつぶつ}を{配布|はいふ}した。
examples.english: A large amount of printed material was distributed.

examples.japanese: デジタル{化|か}が{進|すす}んでも、{印刷物|いんさつぶつ}の{需要|じゅよう}は{完全|かんぜん}にはなくならない。
examples.english: Even as digitalization progresses, the demand for printed materials will not completely disappear.

notes:
Composed of {印刷|いんさつ} (printing) and {物|ぶつ} (thing/object). A general term for anything that has been printed. In postal contexts, {印刷物|いんさつぶつ} is a specific mail category with lower rates than regular letters, similar to "printed matter" classification in international mail.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {印刷物|いんさつぶつ}を{配布|はいふ}する: to distribute printed materials
- {印刷物|いんさつぶつ}{郵便|ゆうびん}: printed matter mail
- {大量|たいりょう}の{印刷物|いんさつぶつ}: large quantity of printed matter
- {印刷物|いんさつぶつ}の{制作|せいさく}: production of printed materials

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {刊行物|かんこうぶつ}: publication — formally published works like books and journals
- {出版物|しゅっぱんぶつ}: published material — commercially published works
- {配布物|はいふぶつ}: handouts, distributed materials — items given out, whether printed or not
